title: Redux Toolkit
simpleMetaphor: A centralized vault to manage global app state in large, complex applications.
technicalExplanation: Standardized toolset for efficient Redux development, simplifying store setup and immutability.

title: Zustand
simpleMetaphor: A lightweight central state notebook for React without boilerplate setup.
technicalExplanation: Small, fast state-management solution based on hook stores with simplified subscription logic.

title: TanStack Query (React Query)
simpleMetaphor: Handles API fetching, automatic background caching, loading states, and updates for you.
technicalExplanation: Powerful asynchronous state manager for fetching, caching, and updating server state in web applications.

title: Jotai
simpleMetaphor: Manage global state using atomic state pieces that trigger re-renders only where needed.
technicalExplanation: Primitive and flexible state management for React based on bottom-up atomic state architecture.

title: React Context API
simpleMetaphor: React's native way to share data across components without manually passing props down.
technicalExplanation: Built-in React feature for passing data through the component tree without prop drilling.
